whyModelDescription: A focused model page should explain where this model is strongest, when to use it, and why it deserves its own workflow entry point.
howItWorksDescription: The page is structured to help users move from model understanding into action without leaving the main creation flow.

howItWorksSteps.title: Choose a mode
howItWorksSteps.copy: Switch between the model's main creation modes and land in the workflow that matches your intent.

howItWorksSteps.title: Add prompt or references
howItWorksSteps.copy: Start from text, references, or both, depending on whether you are generating from scratch or refining assets.

howItWorksSteps.title: Generate and compare
howItWorksSteps.copy: Use the workbench to iterate quickly, compare directions, and keep the strongest candidates moving forward.

howItWorksSteps.title: Continue in creator
howItWorksSteps.copy: Once you have a strong direction, jump into the creator flow to keep working without rebuilding context.

workflowsTitle: One model surface, multiple vertical workflows
workflowsDescription: Instead of presenting feature cards first, the page flows through actual scene intent. Each mode explains what it is for, how to steer it, and how to start with a working prompt.
bestForDescription: Use-case framing helps users understand not just what the model can do, but where it fits best in real production work.
galleryTitle: A premium model page should explain the output, not bury it behind modules
galleryDescription: The overall rhythm follows a vertical editorial layout: hero first, workbench second, then scene logic, product rationale, and real output proof. That keeps the page dense without collapsing into a card wall.
galleryLead: Real outputs should carry the proof. The surrounding copy stays compact, readable, and secondary.
faqTitle: Product framing, not just page styling
faqDescription: Answers stay in the same vertical rhythm so the page still reads like one continuous product narrative instead of a set of detached modules.
fallbackSampleCaption: A real output sample selected from this model's own generation set.
